terms.meaning: Quantity: how many units of a product are being added. The shop page always sends 1 per click.
The code that runs when someone clicks Add: checks the product and stock, then puts it in the cart.
The list of products currently in the cart, one line per product with its quantity. There is a single cart shared by everyone.
Error returned when asking for more units than the product's stock in a single request.
Error returned when the quantity is not a whole number of at least 1.
